name: thergrid

scripts.syntax: find src tests scripts apps \( -path '*/node_modules/*' -o -path '*/dist/*' \) -prune -o \( -name '*.mjs' -o -name '*.js' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check
scripts.check: npm run verify:release && npm run package:aethergrid && npm run package:aethergrid-app && npm run smoke:aethergrid-app && npm run syntax && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict-renderer && npm run format:check && npm run coverage && npm run demo && npm run dashboard-demo
scripts.lint: eslint --max-warnings=0 src tests scripts apps/operator-console/app.js apps/aethergrid-console/app.js apps/aethergrid-console/server.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/web-runtime.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/agent-config.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/ai-runtime.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/profile-store.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/geo-runtime.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/city-environment-runtime.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/city-live-runtime.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/terrain-runtime.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/quantum-runtime.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/config/*.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/security/*.mjs apps/aethergrid-console/providers/*.mjs
scripts.build:aethergrid-web: npm --prefix apps/aethergrid-console/web ci && npm --prefix apps/aethergrid-console/web run build

description: Node.js digital-twin and energy-simulation application service with advisory spatial intelligence, evidence, and operator-review contracts.
